name: get_project_event
description:
Gets detailed information about a specific service health event.

* `name` (string, required): Name of the event using the form `projects/{project_id}/locations/global/events/{event_id}`.

parameters.description: Gets information about a specific event.

name.description: Required. Unique name of the event in this scope including project and location using the form `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/events/{event_id}`. `project_id` - Project ID of the project that contains the event. `location` - The location to get the service health events from. Set this field to `global`. `event_id` - Event ID to retrieve.
